import unittest
from todo import add_todo, complete_todo


class TestAddTodo(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.todos = []
    
    def test_add_single_todo(self):
        """Test adding a single todo item"""
        result = add_todo(self.todos, "Buy milk")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy milk"])
        self.assertEqual(result, ["Buy milk"])
    
    def test_add_multiple_todos(self):
        """Test adding multiple todo items"""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Buy milk")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Walk dog")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Write tests")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy milk", "Walk dog", "Write tests"])
    
    def test_add_returns_updated_list(self):
        """Test that add_todo returns the updated list"""
        result = add_todo(self.todos, "Task 1")
        self.assertIs(result, self.todos)


class TestCompleteTodo(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.todos = ["Buy milk", "Walk dog", "Write tests"]
    
    def test_complete_existing_todo(self):
        """Test completing a todo that exists"""
        complete_todo(self.todos, "Walk dog")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy milk", "Write tests"])
    
    def test_complete_nonexistent_todo(self):
        """Test completing a todo that doesn't exist"""
        result = complete_todo(self.todos, "Nonexistent task")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy milk", "Walk dog", "Write tests"])
    
    def test_complete_returns_updated_list(self):
        """Test that complete_todo returns the updated list"""
        result = complete_todo(self.todos, "Buy milk")
        self.assertIs(result, self.todos)
    
    def test_complete_first_item(self):
        """Test completing the first item in the list"""
        complete_todo(self.todos, "Buy milk")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Walk dog", "Write tests"])
    
    def test_complete_last_item(self):
        """Test completing the last item in the list"""
        complete_todo(self.todos, "Write tests")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy milk", "Walk dog"])


class TestIntegration(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_and_complete_workflow(self):
        """Test a realistic add and complete workflow"""
        todos = []
        add_todo(todos, "Task 1")
        add_todo(todos, "Task 2")
        add_todo(todos, "Task 3")
        self.assertEqual(len(todos), 3)
        
        complete_todo(todos, "Task 2")
        self.assertEqual(todos, ["Task 1", "Task 3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(todos), 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
